extName.description: Extension name shown in chrome://extensions and the Chrome Web Store listing.

extDesc.message: Double-click any word for an instant definition, IPA & example. Save words, study with spaced repetition. BYOK LLM explain.
extDesc.description: Short description shown in chrome://extensions and the Chrome Web Store listing.

heroWordsSaved.description: Hero stat label: count of saved words. $n$ is replaced at runtime with the count.

heroMastered.description: Hero stat label: count of mastered words. $n$ is replaced at runtime with the count.

searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text in the popup's saved-words search input.

sortDate.description: Sort-bar button: sort saved words by date saved (most recent first).

sortAlpha.description: Sort-bar button: sort saved words alphabetically.

sortMastery.description: Sort-bar button: sort saved words by mastery level (highest first).

emptyTitle.message: Double-click any word to start your list
emptyTitle.description: Empty-state headline shown in the popup when the user has no saved words.

emptyBody.message: Your saved words will appear here. Double-click any word on any page to define and save it.
emptyBody.description: Empty-state body copy explaining how to start saving words.

triggerDblclick.description: Toggle-switch label in popup settings: enable double-click trigger.

triggerContext.description: Toggle-switch label in popup settings: enable right-click context menu trigger.

targetLang.description: Popup setting row label. $lang$ is replaced at runtime with the language name (e.g. 'French').

byokKeyLabel.description: Popup setting row label for the BYOK API key input.

byokTest.description: BYOK key test button label (idle state).

byokTesting.description: BYOK key test button label while a test request is in flight.

byokOk.description: BYOK key test button label after a successful test.

byokErr.description: BYOK key test button label after a failed test.

wordsCount.description: Saved-words counter. $n$ is current count, $cap$ is the tier limit (50 for Free).

masteredLabel.description: Label shown next to the mastered count in the hero stat and elsewhere.

optDictSource.description: Options page section title: dictionary source picker.

optTargetLang.description: Options page setting label: target language for translate mode (Pro).

optTheme.description: Options page section title: appearance / theme picker.

optByokTitle.description: Options page section title: BYOK / LLM configuration.

optByokProvider.description: Options page BYOK setting label: LLM provider dropdown.

optByokModel.description: Options page BYOK setting label: model name input.

optByokEndpoint.description: Options page BYOK setting label: custom endpoint URL input (shown only when provider is 'custom').

optExportTitle.description: Options page card title: export study list.

exportCsv.description: Options page button: export saved words as CSV.

exportAnki.description: Options page button: export saved words as Anki-importable TSV.

optReviewTitle.description: Options page card title: spaced repetition settings.

optLicenseTitle.description: Options page section title: license manager.

licensePlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the license key input.

licenseVerifying.description: License activation button label while verification is in flight (also used as a11y label for the spinner).

licenseErr.description: License activation failure message (fallback when the SW does not return a specific error).

onboardingHeroBody.message: Double-click any word. Get an instant definition, IPA, and example — without leaving the page.

onboardingStep1.description: Onboarding step 1 primary button: advance to step 2.

onboardingStep2.description: Onboarding step 2 primary button: advance to step 3.

onboardingStep3.description: Onboarding step 3 primary button: finish onboarding.

onboardingPrivacy.message: Dictionary lookups hit dictionaryapi.dev only. BYOK LLM calls go directly to YOUR endpoint — never sees your key.
onboardingPrivacy.description: Onboarding privacy callout copy. Names the only third-party dictionary host and reaffirms that BYOK keys never touch  servers.

onboardingEnableBroad.description: Onboarding step 2 permission priming: strong text on the grant card.

onboardingBroadGranted.description: Onboarding step 2 permission status message: success after the user grants broad host access.

onboardingBroadDenied.message: Not enabled — Define still works when you click the toolbar icon.
onboardingBroadDenied.description: Onboarding step 2 permission status message: shown when the user denies broad host access.

cardPlayAudio.description: Content-script definition card: audio playback button label.

cardSave.description: Content-script definition card: save-word button label.

cardSaved.description: Content-script definition card: transient success label shown after a word is saved.

cardClose.description: Content-script definition card: close button label.

cardNotFound.message: Select a single word to define.
cardNotFound.description: Content-script definition card: shown when the selection is empty or spans multiple words.

cardTimeout.message: Dictionary lookup timed out. Try again.
cardTimeout.description: Content-script definition card: shown when the dictionary request exceeds the timeout.

cardNetworkErr.description: Content-script definition card: shown when the dictionary request fails with a network/transport error.

cardByokMissing.message: Add your BYOK API key in Settings to use explain-in-context.
cardByokMissing.description: Content-script definition card: shown when the user invokes explain-in-context without a configured BYOK key.

cardExplainContext.description: Content-script definition card: button label for the BYOK explain-in-context action (Pro).

paywallReframe.description: Paywall overlay reframe line: one-time price vs typical monthly subscription.

paywallGuarantee.description: Paywall overlay guarantee line. $n$ is replaced at runtime.
